map.⚡ 粘接方案成本与效率对比（含替代工艺）: ⚡ Bonding Process Cost and Efficiency Comparison (Including Alternatives)
map.逐行录入各粘接方案的材料成本、工时与良品率，折算单件成本与有效工时: Enter the material cost, labor time and yield rate of each bonding option row by row, and convert them to cost per part and effective labor time
map.粘接工艺选型不能只比胶水单价：工时（点胶、定位、固化等待）折算成人工与设备占用往: Bonding process selection cannot compare only the glue unit price: labor time (dispensing, positioning, curing wait) converted into labor and equipment occupancy often exceeds the material itself, and the yield rate spreads rework losses back onto each part. The formula combines the three into a cost per part (material plus labor cost, then divided by the yield rate), and uses "effective labor time = labor time ÷ yield rate" to reflect the extra capacity consumed by rework. The baseline option is the first row, the optimal option is the one with the lowest cost per part, and both the savings rate and the efficiency gain are computed relative to the baseline. Data is calculated only in the local browser and never uploaded.
map.单件成本 =（胶水成本 + 工时 × 工时费率）÷ 良品率；有效工时 = 工时: Cost per part = (glue cost + labor time × labor rate) ÷ yield rate; effective labor time = labor time ÷ yield rate
map.每行输入「方案名,胶水成本(元/件),工时(分钟),工时费率(元/分钟),良品率: Enter "option name, glue cost (CNY/part), labor time (minutes), labor rate (CNY/min), yield rate %" for each row, e.g.: epoxy,3.5,4,0.5,98

map.替代工艺（焊接/铆接/胶带）经济性比较: Economic comparison of alternative processes (welding / riveting / tape)
map.单件成本 =（胶水成本 + 工时 × 工时费率）÷ 良品率；有效工时 = 工时: Cost per part = (glue cost + labor time × labor rate) ÷ yield rate; effective labor time = labor time ÷ yield rate.
map.环氧AB胶 4.0 元、5 分钟、0.6 元/分钟、良品率 96% → 单件 (: Epoxy AB glue 4.0 CNY, 5 minutes, 0.6 CNY/min, yield 96% → per part (4.0+3.0)÷0.96 = 7.29 CNY; hot melt glue 1.8 CNY, 1.5 minutes, 92% → (1.8+0.9)÷0.92 = 2.93 CNY; structural tape 6.0 CNY, 2 minutes, 99% → 7.27 CNY. The best is hot melt glue, saving 59.75% against the baseline, with effective labor time dropping from 5.21 to 1.63 minutes (a 68.70% gain).
map.为什么要把良品率算进去？: Why does the yield rate have to be included?
map.返工件同样消耗材料与工时，除以良品率可把返工损失摊回单件，避免低估低良品率方案的: Reworked parts consume material and labor too, so dividing by the yield rate spreads the rework loss back onto each part and avoids underestimating the true cost of a low-yield option.
map.节省率是相对谁算的？: What is the savings rate relative to?
map.相对第一行方案（基准），单件成本降幅即节省率；可把现用工艺放第一行做对比基准。: It is relative to the first-row option (the baseline): the percentage drop in cost per part is the savings rate. Put the current process in the first row to use it as the comparison baseline.
